description: Reviewed dataset identities and independently justified acquisition streams for the project database. This registry does not describe acquisition events or authorize retention promotion.

datasets.name: Bahraini Unemployed (15 years and above) and the Unemployment Rate by Sex (Yearly)
datasets.description: Bahrain Open Data Portal Opendatasoft dataset 03-unemployment-yearly. Dataset metadata and complete paginated records are captured together for each timestamped observation snapshot.

metadata.validation_disposition: Reuse the existing Bahrain unemployment assessment and approval evidence; do not reopen or infer disposition from matching hashes.
metadata.capture_unit: One acquisition contains dataset_metadata.json and every records page for the same retrieval timestamp.

validation_contract.source_specific_validation: Existing approved Bahrain assessment; reference its established disposition.

metadata.release_semantics: Timestamped observation snapshot of a rolling provider dataset, not a semantic provider vintage.
metadata.evidence: Three tracked manifests identify the same provider dataset and each include metadata plus its records page.

datasets.name: UN M49 country and area overview
datasets.description: United Nations Statistics Division country/area reference page containing M49 codes, ISO cross-references and regional hierarchy.

metadata.manifest_adapter_status: The existing alternate manifest representation is preserved; this registration does not normalize it.

streams.name: UN M49 current reference page captures

metadata.release_semantics: Rolling current-reference page; changed content is a new candidate capture, not an inferred semantic edition.
metadata.evidence: One tracked manifest defines a single page capture with a reusable content contract.

datasets.name: IMF World Economic Outlook database
datasets.description: IMF WEO statistical database. The October 2026 CSV export and its vintage-specific Database Appendix are one manual acquisition bundle with distinct artifact roles.

metadata.acquisition_status: Files are tracked and documented, but this registry entry does not claim formal manifest validation, semantic validation, approval, or application.

validation_contract.bundle_completeness: CSV dataset and matching vintage Database Appendix must be associated with the same acquisition.
validation_contract.semantic_validation: Separate source-specific WEO validation; not performed by catalogue registration.

metadata.release_semantics: One acquisition per identified WEO vintage; repeated captures of a vintage remain distinct acquisition events.
metadata.evidence: The manual acquisition record identifies both files as the October 2026 WEO database and appendix, with distinct roles.
metadata.open_gate: Formal acquisition manifest and source-specific validation are still separate work.

datasets.name: WPP 2024 demographic indicators — medium variant
datasets.description: UN World Population Prospects 2024 standard CSV demographic indicators, medium variant.

metadata.stream_boundary_reason: WPP main edition and supplementary materials have an approved combined application; independent retention boundaries have not yet been approved.

datasets.name: WPP 2024 population by age (5-year groups) and sex — medium variant
datasets.description: UN World Population Prospects 2024 population by age group and sex, medium variant.

metadata.stream_boundary_reason: WPP main edition and supplementary materials have an approved combined application; independent retention boundaries have not yet been approved.

datasets.name: WDI selected macroeconomic indicators (annual API snapshot)
datasets.description: A bounded annual World Development Indicators API capture for IMF WEO comparability assessment. Contains five primary candidate indicators plus the national unemployment estimate as a separate diagnostic series; not a source-selection approval.

metadata.licensing: CC BY 4.0 default for World Bank-produced datasets; third-party indicator exceptions require review.

streams.name: WDI selected indicator rolling API snapshots

validation_contract.semantic_validation: Separate assessment; acquisition and provenance registration do not approve or apply observations.

metadata.release_semantics: One timestamped capture of a rolling API response bundle; not a provider-declared WDI vintage.
metadata.event_identity: Manifest repository-relative path; repeated captures remain distinct events.
metadata.capture_unit: One acquisition contains source metadata, all country metadata pages, all primary and diagnostic indicator metadata/responses, six supporting decomposition indicator metadata/responses, and every observation page for each indicator.
metadata.observation_status: Preserve API obs_status verbatim; only explicit status interpretation belongs to a separate validation step.
metadata.supporting_series_purpose: Supporting indicators enable arithmetic diagnostics for current-USD GDP conversion, PPP conversion, GDP-per-capita denominator, and CPI index growth. They do not establish the provider's internal construction or semantic comparability.

datasets.name: Guinea national accounts — legacy series in La Guinée en chiffres 2023
datasets.description: INS yearbook containing historical national accounts on the legacy SNA 1993/2006-base series, retained separately from the revised 2018-base SNA 2008 accounts.

metadata.statistical_basis: Legacy SNA 1993 / 2006 base as described in the source assessment.
metadata.capture_unit: One official INS yearbook PDF per publication acquisition.

streams.name: Guinea INS legacy national-accounts publication captures

validation_contract.source_specific_validation: Verify PDF structure and inspect the national-accounts tables; registration does not validate statistical values.

metadata.release_semantics: One acquisition per identified yearbook publication; later yearbooks or recaptures are separate events.
metadata.evidence: Official INS yearbook URL; historical series is kept distinct from the 2018-base SNA 2008 publication.

datasets.name: Guinea national accounts — 2018-base SNA 2008 accounts (June 2026 note)
datasets.description: INS note publishing definitive 2018-2020 and rapid 2021-2024 national accounts on the revised 2018 base under SNA 2008.

metadata.statistical_basis: SNA 2008, 2018 base; 2018-2020 definitive and 2021-2024 rapid estimates according to the publication.
metadata.capture_unit: One official INS national-accounts note PDF per publication acquisition.

streams.name: Guinea INS revised national-accounts publication captures

validation_contract.source_specific_validation: Verify PDF structure, publication vintage and definitive/rapid status; registration does not approve statistical values.

metadata.release_semantics: One acquisition per identified revised national-accounts publication; future revisions remain separate events.
metadata.evidence: Official INS June 2026 publication URL; kept separate from the legacy yearbook.
